Mujaphpharpur men lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ke tisre din ravivar ko vratiyon ne astachalgami sury ko pahla arghy arpit kiya. iske sath hi pura shahar chhathi maiya ki bhakti men duba najar aaya.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
